title: Nisane int. 1, beginning
source_text:
Aḥna gəmšaylínalax kmo+šuwole ʕal aḥ+ḥayayḏax. 
 ʕAl aḥ+ḥayayḏi? 
E yade, uʕdo dəmaḷḷux yani, b̥šayno aṯutu, elo uʕdo . 
. . i+moda dwáxtak̇e, dʕumrayna bášqayo, ŭ uʕdo bášqayo. 
ʕUmrayna, laḥmo dəsʕore uxlíwayna, koṯe lboli i+Ġala, laḥmo dǧaǧəq, dag+gelone, dab+baluṭe uxlíwayna. 
Ŭ faqiríyewa, hăma ʕayšíwayna ʕal u+săwā̀l, ŭ baṭ+ṭurone lag+gelone, ŭ dawriwa bi+ḥaraytaṯe, edi dawríwayna. 
Yani, azzano lu+čōlste mu+kafno.   
Aṯina lu+ṭuro, ŭ babi dowarwa, ŭ aḥunoni ḥəfriwa hawxa qăfare, ŭ ḥuṣdíwayna. 
Edi hawina čik̇e . 
. . raġlan aṯyo quman, sawiʕina, sawiʕina. 
Hawxa mbelan ʕumran, ṣawmo ŭ ṣluṯo, mṣalíwayna, li+ʕito əzzáwayna, əḏʕíwayna bi+qima di+ʕito, du+qašo. 
Aš+šamoše oṯənwa li+ʕito kul+ḥušabo, ŭ hawxa mašfaʕlan ʕumran bi+xwašiye.   
 Hăma čik̇e hani am+mašəlmone saymiwa năḥaqqiye aʕlan, ŭ hawxa mbelan ʕumran hul uʕdo, xud komar ʕAziz. 
Ṭәlbíwaylan, lo+ḥozíwayna a+zlamat, lo+ḥozíwayna ḥḏoḏe, u+mede deman ŭ dbaban dәmmiwa – tămāmwa,dәmmiwa obə́nwaylan lәḥḏoḏe, tămāmwa. 
Yani maqblíwayna u+mamro deman ŭ dbaban. 
Lo+ḥozíwayna ḥḏoḏe, lo+mәǧġolíwayna ʕam ḥḏoḏe dlo+miḥawlíwayna.  
E, ŭʕdo ánnaqqa kokŭrxi ʕam ḥḏoḏe, kohnәn. 
mqapṭéwayna ha hawxa xŭd ŭʕdo, mqapṭéwayna, dәsmalat ʕal qarʕayna, aǧ+ǧule  hawxa yarixe aʕlayna. 
hē i+modayḏan háyoyo, he i+modayḏan háyoyo. 
ak+kaloṯe  dmiḥawliwa  kə́twaylan әmmíwayna bušiyat dabrisam kome, ʕal haqqa mnaqšéwayne čәzgәliyat yaroqe, šaʕuṯe, pamba, ar+rišikaṯṯe haqqa bәrmiwa tloṯo+hne hawxa ʕal qarʕayna, ŭ  qŭṭrə́nwanne harke,  ha qarʕayna howewa ha hawxa, maḥtiwa dәsmale šaʕәṯto ʕal foṯayna, ŭ fuṭa. 
ayna dkə́twayle kallawat abrisam, dlatwa šuqo, disa damli  mnaqašto, maḥtiwa ha hawxa.
u+yawmawo mәḷḷi, gaḥixi, ha hawxa maḥtíwayna qarʕan bi+arʕo, nәfqíwayna әmmíwayna, di+dawla dbabayna lŭṯyo aʕmayna ŭ lo+nәfqíwayna tloṯo+yawmeste me lawġŭl, lo+qaymíwayna lo+nәfqíwayna, әmmíwayna, ‘ḥṭiṯoyo, b+arbʕina, ŭ lo+hno’. 
ánnaqqa ŭʕdo konәfqi ak+kaloṯe kǝmmi, lәklәk lәk gŭḥxi, ʕam ax+xelvaniye, hawxa kogŭḥxi.  
hawxa medone hawxa, saymíwayna.
ʕAziz u+abràyḏaxyo?
 U+ḥaṯnàyḏiyo. 
Ono i+emo d Ḥánano, e. 
Ono me Derqúbeno
